text: `utilz upgrade` upgrades the tree it runs from, as that tree is upgraded. In dev it pulls fast-forward, refusing over a dirty runtime set, then runs `bin/devbin build` and prints the version line. In opt it writes nothing and names the republish. In brew it runs `brew update`, then `brew upgrade utilz` with HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 only when brew names utilz as outdated, and it fails by name when either step fails.
